question: Which one of the following statements regarding magnetic field is correct?

options.text: Magnetic field lines are open curves
Magnetic field lines are closed curves
Magnetic field is a quantity that has no direction and magnitude
two magnetic field lines are found to cross each other

solution:
The correct answer is __**Magnetic field lines are closed curves**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Magnetic field lines are closed curves** which means they form continuous loops without beginning or end.
 
• These lines emerge from the north pole of a magnet and enter the south pole, continuing inside the magnet back to the north pole.
